titulo: Direct vs indirect free kick: watch the referee's arm #shorts
descripcion:
Arm up means indirect. A direct free kick can go in untouched; an indirect one cannot (if it does, it's a goal kick). Inside the box, a direct free kick offence is a penalty and an indirect one stays an indirect free kick.

Source: Laws 12 and 13, Laws of the Game 2026/27 (The IFAB), via https://futbolatlas.app/k/direct-vs-indirect-free-kick
